name: Witch Hunter ~Choroi ze Aku no Onna Kanbu~
original_name: ウィッチハンター ～ちょろいぜ悪の女幹部～
source:
After a fierce battle, the protagonist, reveling in his victory after capturing the magical girls Angelic Rose and Angelic Aqua, is suddenly attacked by Azrael Dues, who was supposed to be his ally.

It turns out that Azrael was ordered to punish the protagonist when her superiors discovered his plot to betray the organization.

The protagonist, now possessing magical powers thanks to the cooperation of the magical girls, against Azrael, who has awakened to her own sadistic tendencies.

"To make Azrael my sex slave."
"To make the protagonist my sex toy."

A battle begins between the two, putting sexual fetishes and pride on the line.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/witchhunter/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
translation:
经过一场激烈的战斗，主角在捕获了魔法少女天使罗丝和天使阿库娅后，正沉浸在胜利的喜悦之中，却突然遭到了本应是自己盟友的阿兹瑞尔·杜斯的袭击。

原来，当上级发现主角背叛组织的阴谋时，阿兹莉尔奉命惩罚主角。

在魔法少女们的配合下，主角获得了魔力，对抗觉醒了施虐倾向的阿兹莉尔。

“让阿兹瑞尔成为我的性奴隶。”
“让主角成为我的性玩具。”

两人之间展开了一场战斗，赌上性恋物和自尊心。
